about.title: About Jadara
about.story: Jadara started in the heart of Tiaret as a youth initiative believing that real skill deserves space to be proven, not just a certificate to be folded.
about.why: Thousands of young people possess genuine skills that their academic degrees alone do not reflect, while companies seek reliable competencies without the hassle of traditional screening.
about.vision: We aspire for Jadara to become the trusted national reference for documenting Algerian youth competencies.
about.community: The Jadara community grows day by day through field meetings and workshops that bring together youth, trainers, and experts, supported by field partners, foremost among them the Directorate of Youth and Sports of Tiaret. Together, we build an environment that links youth with the skills of the future, and opens doors to exchange experiences and build tangible joint projects.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about how to use the platform and document your skills.
faq.notAnswered: Didn't find your answer? Contact us
faq.a1: Yes, registering on Jadara, documenting, and verifying your skills is completely free for beneficiaries.
faq.q2: How do I add and prove a skill?
faq.a2: From your dashboard, go to the Skills section, click 'Add Skill', then attach a document or project link as proof of evidence and submit it for review.
faq.q3: What types of evidence are accepted?
faq.a3: We accept academic or professional certificates, links to applied projects (e.g., GitHub or Behance), or documents proving past work experience.
faq.q4: How long does the evidence review take?
faq.a4: Verification usually takes between 3 to 7 working days, during which a specialized reviewer examines and assesses the attached proof.
faq.q5: What happens if my proof is rejected?
faq.a5: You will receive a notification detailing the reasons for rejection and the reviewer's notes. You can modify the proof or attach a new document and submit again.
faq.q6: Can I edit or delete a proof of evidence after uploading it?
faq.a6: Yes, you can manage your documents, delete or replace them from your library, provided they are not currently under review or associated with an approved badge.
faq.q7: What is a Skill Badge and how do I earn it?
faq.a7: A Skill Badge is a verified digital stamp proving your competency. You earn it automatically once an accredited reviewer approves the proof linked to your skill.
faq.q8: Can companies view my profile without my consent?
faq.a8: No, you control your profile visibility to partner companies at any time via your account privacy settings.
faq.a9: Yes, we prioritize your privacy and data protection. We follow strict standards to secure your information; for more details, please read our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introDesc: At Jadara, we are committed to protecting the privacy of your personal data and explaining how we collect, use, and protect it.
privacy.collectDesc: We collect information necessary to provide our services, including: full name, email address, phone number, date of birth, gender, address, uploaded evidence documents, and profile photo.
privacy.useDesc: Data is used to verify the credibility of your skills and issue digital badges. Your public profile is displayed to partner companies only if you enable the visibility option.
privacy.accessDesc: Only accredited reviewers access the documents you attach for verification. Partner companies only access your verified public profile if you grant permission.
privacy.rightsDesc: You have the full right to edit your personal data at any time, hide your profile from search, or request the permanent deletion of your account from the platform.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptDesc: By using the Jadara platform, you express your full and unconditional agreement to these terms and conditions.
terms.useDesc: Impersonating others is prohibited. Uploading forged, fake, or incorrect evidence documents is strictly forbidden. The user bears full legal responsibility for the accuracy of their documents.
terms.ipDesc: Users retain ownership of the content and documents they upload. Platform design, trademarks, and certified digital skill badges remain the intellectual property of Jadara.
terms.terminationDesc: Platform administrators reserve the full right to disable or terminate any account that violates the terms of service or uploads forged evidence.
terms.liabilityDesc: Jadara acts as a skill-verification intermediary. It is not an employer or a legal guarantor of employment outcomes or specific recruitment results.
